{Black threatens to play b5 to defend the c4 pawn. How can White prevent that
move?} 8. Nfd2 {[%wrong There's a better move to prevent b7-b5 and win the
c4-pawn. Try to find it.] [%hint Use a discovery to attack the c6-knight.]} (8.
a4 $2 Be7 {That's playable, but there's another move that prevents b5 and
threatens the c4-pawn immediately. Try to find it.}) (8. Nc3 $2 b5 {Black will
make it hard for White to regain the pawn. Try again and look for a way to
control the long light diagonal.}) (8. Ne5 $2 Nxe5 {Black is happy to double
your pawns and trade queens. Try to find a stronger knight move.}) 8... Na5 {
Good move! Na5 only made things worse for Black. How can White go about trying
to win that piece?} 9. Qa4+ {[%wrong There's a better move to find a powerful
fork.] [%hint Use a fork to try to win Black's knight on a5.]} (9. b4 $2 Bxb4 {
Black is OK. If Qa4+ is next then Nc6 saves both the knight and bishop. Try again
and look for an immediate fork.}) 9... c6 {Well played! How can you attack the
knight on a5 again?} 10. b4 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again to
attack the knight.] [%hint Look for a good way to win the a5-knight.]} (10.
Nxc4 $2 Nxc4 {White's slightly better, but Black should be OK. Try to get more!
}) (10. Qxa5 $2 Qxa5 {Watch out!}) 10... cxb3 {Nice move! How can you keep up
the pressure on a5?} 11. axb3 {[%wrong There's a better move to attack a5
again. Try to find it.] [%hint Use a discovery to attack a5 again.]} (11. Nxb3
$2 Nxb3 {White's OK, but you want to win the knight, not just trade for it.})
11... b6 {Good move! How can you attack that knight one more time?} 12. b4 {
[%wrong That doesn't threaten to win a piece on a5. Try again.] [%hint
Threaten the knight on a5 one more time.] Well played! Black must play Nb7.
White will win one or two queenside pawns with a big advantage.} *

{White has sacrificed two pawns, but will soon win back material. How should
you do it?} 8. Nxd4 {[%wrong There's a stronger move. Try to find a good
capture.] [%hint Sacrifice your knight to win a pawn and clear the long
diagonal.]} (8. Qxc4 $2 Qb6 {Black is OK. Try to find a stronger capture.}) (8.
Nbd2 $2 Nd7 {Black has a comfortable position. Try to find a strong capture.})
(8. Ne5 $2 Bd7 {Black is better. Try to find a stronger knight move.}) 8...
Qxd4 {Nice move! How can you win back the sacrificed piece?} 9. Bxc6+ {[%wrong
There's a stronger move. Try to find a good capture.] [%hint Capture a piece
with check.]} (9. Rd1 $2 Qb6 {Black is winning. Try to find a strong capture.})
9... Bd7 {Good move! How should White keep the initiative?} 10. Rd1 {[%wrong
There's a better move. Try to find it and check the hint if you're stuck.] 
[%hint Develop and attack the black queen.] Well played! You can continue the
game in the next challenge.} (10. Bxd7+ $2 Qxd7 {Black is OK. Try to find a
strong threat.}) (10. Bxb7 $2 Bxa4 {Black is winning. Try again.}) (10. Be3 $2
Qd6 {Black is OK. Try to find a stronger way to threaten the black queen.}) *

{How should White keep an advantage if Black recaptures on c6 with the bishop?
} 11. Qxc6+ {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a precise
capture.] [%hint Sacrifice your queen to damage the black pawn structure.]} (
11. Rxd4 $2 Bxa4 {Black keeps an extra piece. Try again and look for a
stronger capture.}) 11... bxc6 {Good idea! What's next?} 12. Rxd4 {[%wrong
Black has too much material. Try again and look for a strong capture.] [%hint
Capture the queen.] Well played! Black's isolated pawns will be difficult to
defend and White has an easy game.} *

{Black is ahead by a pawn, but has several pieces in danger. What's the best
way to reach a solid position?} 10... Qxd1+ {[%wrong There's a better move.
Try again and look for a strong capture.] [%hint Sacrifice your queen to put an
end to White's initiative.]} (10... Bxc6 $2 11. Qxc6+ {White damages the black
pawn structure and keeps a significant advantage. Try again and look for a
stronger capture.}) 11. Qxd1 {Good choice! What should you capture next?} Bxc6
{[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a precise capture.] 
[%hint Capture the bishop without doubling your pawns.] Good work! Black has a
rook, bishop, and pawn as compensation for White's queen. The position is close
to even.} (11... bxc6 $2 {There's no need to damage your own pawn structure.
Try to find a better capture.}) *

{How can Black fight for control of the long light diagonal?} 7... b5 {[%wrong
There's a better option. Look for the strongest way to attack the White queen.]
[%hint Attack White's queen and make room for the c8-bishop to develop.]} (7...
c5 $5 {This is a strong move, but it's even better to attack the white queen.
How should you do it?}) (7... Nb6 $2 8. Qc2 {The knight on b6 makes it hard to
develop the c8-bishop to a good position. Try to find a better way to attack
White's queen.}) (7... Be7 $2 8. Ne5 {White keeps a space advantage and a good
position. Try to find a good way to attack White's queen.}) (7... Bd6 $2 8. Qc2
{White keeps a space advantage and a good position. Try to find a good way to
attack White's queen.}) (7... b6 $2 8. Ne5 {White threatens Nc6 and Bxa8. Try
again and look for a better way to prepare Bb7.}) 8. Qc2 {Great start! How
should you develop a bishop?} Bb7 {[%wrong There's a better developing move.
Try to find it.] [%hint Develop and control the a8-h1 diagonal.] Great choice!
Black has good development and a safe position.} (8... c5 $5 {This is
reasonable, but it's better to develop and fight for the long diagonal. How
should you do it?}) (8... Be7 $2 9. Ne5 {White attacks the a8-rook. Try to
find a better way to develop a bishop.}) (8... Bd6 $2 9. Ne5 {White attacks
the a8-rook. Try to find a better way to develop a bishop.}) (8... Bb4+ $2 9.
Bd2 {White keeps control of the position. Try to find a better way to develop
a bishop.}) 1-0

{How should White break open the center to take the initiative?} 9. e4 {
[%wrong There's a better option. Try again and look for a strong pawn break.] 
[%hint Occupy the center with another pawn.]} (9. cxd5 $2 cxd5 {Black has
a solid center and no issues developing. Try again and look for a stronger pawn
move.}) (9. b3 $2 c5 {Black fights for the center on equal terms. Try again
and look for a stronger pawn advance.}) (9. Rd1 $5 {This is reasonable, but
there's a pawn break that's stronger. Try to find it.}) (9. Ne5 $2 Nxe5 {
Black doesn't mind the trade on e5. Try again and look for a useful pawn break.
}) 9... dxe4 {Good choice! How should you recapture?} 10. Nxe4 {[%wrong
There's a better option. Try again and look for a good capture.] [%hint
Recapture in the center.] Well played! You can see White's attacking potential
in the next several challenges.} (10. Ne5 $2 Bb7 {Black has a safe position.
Try again and look for a strong capture.}) (10. Qxe4 $2 Nxe4 {Black wins the
queen. Try again and look for a stronger capture.}) *

{How should White continue the attack after Black's Ra8-b8?} 15. dxc5 {[%wrong

Capture a pawn and open the d-file.]} (15. Be4 $5 {White is doing well, but
there's a capture that's stronger. Try to find it.}) (15. Bxg5 $2 Qxg5 {
Black has a safe position. Try again and look for a stronger capture.}) (15.
Bg2 $2 Bxc1 {Black has a safe position. Try again and look for a precise
capture.}) 15... Rxb7 {Great move! How can you win back the sacrificed piece?}
16. c6 {[%wrong There's a better option. Try again and look for a powerful
pawn fork.] [%hint Fork the black rook and knight.]} (16. Bxg5 $5 {This is OK,

again and look for a strong capture.] [%hint Capture the knight and attack the

precise. Try to find it.}) (17. cxd7 $5 {This is OK, but another capture is
even more precise. Try to find it.}) 17... Rxd7 {Well played! What should you
capture next?} 18. Bxg5 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for
a precise capture.] [%hint Capture a piece and attack the black queen.]} (18.
cxd7 $2 Bxc1 {There's no need to let Black win the d7-pawn. Try again and look

[%hint Capture the rook.] Well done! White has an extra pawn and it's the
powerful passer on d7.} *
